a.lede: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.
a.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

b.lede: After sounding an alarm about the issue, Apple is taking steps to limit Mac disk access to AI agents.
b.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok
